item.title: [C-0321] Purify Cu Husburd
item.description:
#career

Alchemist.

Abilities

Green flame metal control

  • Can use Flame Reaction to be a green metal substance

  • Copper (emerald)

    • Boron (turquoise)
    • Barium (yellow-green)
    • Zinc (blue-green or colorless)

Barium

Barium metal has only a small number of applications in industry. It has been used in the past as a getter in vacuum tubes. Barium is a component of YBCO (a high-temperature superconductor) and electroceramics, and can also be added to steel to reduce the number of carbon particles in the metal’s makeup. Barium compounds are used to create the green color in fireworks. Barium sulfate is added to drilling fluids as an insoluble heavy additive, and in medicine it is used as an X-ray contrast agent. Soluble barium salts are toxic because they ionize into barium ions, and are therefore also used as rat poison.

It is said that in this place, people who are afraid of death can see a red sea and a rain that will never stop.

A bear-shaped man named Earfish occasionally travels here, but he always notices a cat-shaped man named Fire Claw.

item.title: [K-0122] An absolutely rational person with desires
item.description:
Appearance

  • Appears to be around 28–35, actual age unknown - Not important
  • Pale green pupils with a light gold ring on the edge, showing a faint iridescence under light
  • Minimalistic attire: playful T-shirts, portable neural recording rings and wrist-worn physiological sensors are always on your body
  • I often wear a grain-free silver ring on my fingertips to slightly focus my thoughts.

#Personality & Motivation

  • MBTI: ENTJ; treat emotions as noise and only reveal “simulated emotions” when necessary to reduce gaming resistance.
  • The value function is clear: maximize long-term structural benefits while maintaining the sustainable supply of its own reward system.
  • Have desires, but do not deny them: indulge in the sense of clarity and conquest brought by dopamine/endorphins, but use reason to abstract desires into “adjustable rewards.”
  • Likes to “witness intellectual conquests” - whether he accomplishes it himself or sees others changing the distribution of group strategies with insights, he will feel “system-level pleasure”.

item.title: [K-1647] Cloak Cloak
item.description:
#Basic description

External composition

  1. Material composition: half carbon-based and half silicon-based life.
  2. Appearance: The head shape has feline characteristics.
  3. Clothing: Cloak with hood, see the [Clothing] section for details.

Internal definition

  1. Behavioral motivation: Transformed from somewhere, in order to find his own definition, he began to come into contact with carbon-based life.
  2. Don’t be hungry but know how to enjoy food.

#clothing

About the cloak

  1. dilapidated.
  2. Color changeable. By default, it is the same color as the wearer, and the cloak comes with a hood.
  3. The form inside the cloak is slender and cat-like by default, but will change according to the carbon-based life forms it has been exposed to in the past 7 days.

About the hood

  1. The hood has an outline that fits the shape of the cat’s ears. Generally, the hood is not worn.
  2. You need to come into contact with carbon-based life during the day (actually even if you come into contact with the earth), additional intelligence will be generated during the contact, which will be temporarily stored in the hood.
  3. You need to wear a hood at night to digest the knowledge accumulated during the day.

external connections

  1. Place of birth: Daytime in a jungle somewhere.
  2. Date of birth: unknown.

Supplement · Voice in the head

  • The K-1647 model has multiple “modules” inside, up to 42 of which can communicate at the same time (see “Two in 100,000” ).
  • In the story, they speak in different brackets: [ ] is the cloak, which is the inspection module; 〖〗 is the emotion module; / … / is the master.
  • Appearance: 0x01 Breath .
